key_message: Gamcheon is a neighbourhood people live in, not a viewpoint — and it rewards being visited that way.

threads.text:
Most photographs of Gamcheon are taken from the same place, and the caption underneath is usually "Korea's Machu Picchu".

That nickname was the title of a 2009 arts competition entry. It did not come from anyone who lives there.

Walk down into it instead. Laundry on a line. Shoes outside a door. A staircase that is somebody's way home.

Those are front doors. People are behind them.

https://www.sojournkorea.net/private-tour

thread: Gamcheon's nickname — "Korea's Machu Picchu" — was the title of a 2009 arts competition entry. It was never local folklore.
The stepped rows aren't decoration either. On a slope that steep you stack the houses so no house stands directly in front of another.
What the photographs leave out is that it is uphill, and that those doors along the stairs are front doors.
Tell us your dates and we build the day around you. https://www.sojournkorea.net/private-tour
